text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was heading to the park 
with Nishino Flower and Wonder Acute, 
having been invited to a picnic the other 
day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The sun is so warm and cozy, it feels so 
nice.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm so glad the weather is nice! The 
flowers are sure to be full of energy like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. The roadside flowers look so nice 
and comfy too, don't they... Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's mugwort. Let's pick a little to 
take with us. If you put it in the bath, 
it makes you sweat a lot, which is really 
good for your body.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I have a bag, so shall we put it in 
here?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, what a fine view. You can see 
quite far into the distance."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, you're right. Shall we take a short 
break?

On the way to the park, we picked wild 
flowers, took breaks, and strolled along 
leisurely at our own pace. After taking 
quite a while, we finally arrived at the 
park.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~, the flowers are blooming so 
beautifully~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. Just lookin' at it puts a natural 
smile on my face~.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Tag! You're it next!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! That didn't hit me just now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho-ho, the children are so lively~.

...What an extraordinarily laid-back 
atmosphere. Seeing how completely relaxed 
they are, it almost makes you doubt 
they're actually students.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, shall we have some tea?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I made some daikon radish candy and 
brought it over. You like daikon, right, 
Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Did ya go outta your way to make 
this for me? Thanks a bunch~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Would you care for one too, Trainer?

However, taking it easy once in a while 
might not be so bad after all...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ah, a cat!? Watch out, dodge it!!

Startled by a child's scream, I looked 
over and saw a cat beneath a park 
maintenance truck. Directly above the cat, 
a wooden crate on the truck bed was 
teetering, about to fall!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Hiss--!!

Even if we try to help, the cat seems to 
be panicking—we can't predict its next 
move!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whoa!
(Booooom!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"That was a close one~. Shoo, shoo, off 
you go."

text_block_list.name: Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!! Are you hurt!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's fine, it's fine. It's nothing at all~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um! Should I load this luggage onto the 
truck bed?

text_block_list.name: Park Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much... wait, are you 
all right!? It's packed with fertilizer, 
so it should be pretty heavy even for an 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, this much is fine! I might not look 
it, but I'm actually quite strong!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... The cart's cargo has tumbled 
over. Let's take it all down and reload it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew~ I'm so glad the cat didn't get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But still, Acute-san's movements 
were incredible!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Dynamic visual acuity is the one thing 
I'm confident in. Speaking of which, 
Flower-chan is quite something too. You're 
surprisingly strong, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, no, really! But I'm happy to hear 
that. Ehehehe...

Despite both having put on such amazing 
performances, they are acting unbelievably 
laid-back...
choice_data_list:
The secret to strength is taking it 
easy...!?

So you both had a hidden talent like that, 
huh.

So you both had a hidden talent like that, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.text:
Despite both having put on such amazing 
performances, they are acting unbelievably 
laid-back...
choice_data_list:
The secret to strength is taking it 
easy...!?

So you both had a hidden talent like that, 
huh.

So you both had a hidden talent like that, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I've never really 
thought about it before, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because she holds back normally, she's 
able to unleash her full power when it 
really counts!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Then, I'd better take it even easier~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. We must be prepared just in case!

Afterward, the three of us spent a 
relaxing time together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't call it a special skill... 
more like a habit? It felt like my body 
just moved on its own."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. It's just second nature to 
me at this point, so it's not really fancy 
enough to call a "technique" or anything.

Their success might have seemed 
surprising, but to them, it was probably 
nothing out of the ordinary—
